isApproved.description: Whether the rule is approved and active for matching searches.

scope.description: Search Index and language scope in which the rule applies.

word.description: Compound word governed by the rule.

head.description: Term that identifies what the compound word represents, or null when the rule prevents decompounding.

modifierCount.description: Number of terms that modify the Head.

preventsDecompounding.description: Whether the rule keeps Word intact instead of splitting it into a Head and Modifiers.

modifiers.description: Terms that modify the Head. Empty when the rule prevents decompounding.

description: Detailed Decompounding rule representation including its modifier terms.
